new.s: In the 2026 AP gram panchayat polls, Phase II polling is on
new.x: The AP State Election Commission fixed Phase II of the 2026 gram panchayat polls for 29 Nov 2026 (Phase I 26 Nov, Phase III 2 Dec).

new.s: How many urban local bodies in AP go to polls on 26 Nov 2026?
new.x: Polling is held on 26 Nov 2026 in 23 AP urban local bodies (4 municipal corporations and 19 municipalities), with a local holiday declared.

new.x: Under G.O. Rt. No. 1111 (Nov 2026) a unanimously elected AP panchayat with over 10,000 people gets ₹50 lakh (₹15 lakh up to 5,000; ₹25 lakh for 5,001-10,000).

new.s: AP declared whose birth anniversary, 16 November, a State Function in Nov 2026?
new.x: In Nov 2026 AP declared Ramoji Rao's birth anniversary (16 November) a State Function to be observed every year.

new.s: The AP Robotics and Physical AI Policy notified in Nov 2026 covers the period
new.x: AP's Robotics and Physical AI Policy, notified by G.O. Ms. No. 86 on 16 Nov 2026, runs for ten years, 2026–2036.

new.s: In Nov 2026 CM Naidu asked the Centre to enact a national law to
new.x: On 14 Nov 2026 CM Naidu sought a national Investors' Protection Act so that approvals, MoUs and incentives cannot be cancelled arbitrarily by later governments.

new.s: AP's escrow account system for paying industrial incentives became operational on
new.x: AP's escrow account for industrial incentives, including to MSMEs, became operational on 12 Nov 2026.

new.s: Who chairs the TTD Special Authority constituted on 2 Nov 2026?
new.x: The TTD Special Authority set up by G.O.Ms.No.658 on 2 Nov 2026 is chaired by TTD Executive Officer Muddada Ravichandra.

new.s: The TTD Special Authority (Nov 2026) was constituted under Section ___ of the AP Endowments Act, 1987
new.x: The TTD Special Authority was constituted under Section 137 of the AP Charitable and Hindu Religious Institutions and Endowments Act, 1987.

new.s: Theme of AP's Newborn Care Week-2026 (15–21 Nov)
new.x: AP observed Newborn Care Week-2026 from 15 to 21 Nov with the theme 'Newborns – Precious Wealth'.

new.s: Which AP government medical college admitted its first MBBS batch in 2026–27?
new.x: Piduguralla Government Medical College admitted its first MBBS batch (50 seats) in 2026–27, when Dr NTR UHS filled 99.88% of seats.

new.x: In Nov 2026 AP raised the minimum engineering college fee from ₹40,000 to ₹47,000 as an interim revision for the 2026–29 block.

new.s: The name of Cyclone Akvan (Nov 2026), which threatened the AP coast, was given by
new.x: Akvan, the cyclone that threatened coastal AP in Nov 2026, is a name contributed by Iran to the North Indian Ocean list.

new.s: Preliminary losses AP reported to the Centre (Nov 2026) from cyclones Arnab and Murasu
new.x: On 17 Nov 2026 CM Naidu told FM Sitharaman that the preliminary losses from cyclones Arnab and Murasu exceeded ₹7,000 crore.

new.s: Under P4, which company agreed (Nov 2026) to support 25,000 families in 100 AP villages?
new.x: At the CII Summit on 13 Nov 2026 ITC agreed with the Swarnandhra P4 Foundation to support 25,000 families in 100 villages.

new.s: AP's 'Best Teachers' are to be sent for training (announced Nov 2026) to
new.x: Nara Lokesh announced on 11 Nov 2026 that AP's Best Teachers will be trained in Singapore during the summer holidays.

new.s: Most common problem in AP's welfare-hostel health survey (1–13 Nov 2026)
new.x: The AP welfare-hostel survey of 2,65,556 students (1–13 Nov 2026) found skin diseases most common (4,436), then anaemia (3,218).

new.s: Where was AP's NCD 4.0 screening survey launched (17 Sep 2025)?
new.x: CM Naidu launched the NCD 4.0 survey at Visakhapatnam on 17 Sep 2025; it ended on 10 Nov 2026 after screening 2.85 crore adults.

new.s: Hypertension prevalence among AP adults found by the NCD 4.0 survey (Nov 2026)
new.x: AP's NCD 4.0 survey found hypertension in 13.93% and diabetes in 11.45% of adults.

new.s: Which cancer had the most confirmed cases in AP's NCD 4.0 survey?
new.x: Of 12,768 cancers confirmed in NCD 4.0, breast cancer was the largest (5,832), then cervical (3,597) and oral (3,339).

new.s: AP's peak power demand projected (Nov 2026) for the next six months
new.x: At the 18 Nov 2026 Energy review AP projected peak demand of 14,852 MW over six months, with consumption up 18.23%.

new.s: AP's rank in PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar installations (Nov 2026)
new.x: With 7,39,260 households by 15 Nov 2026, AP ranks 4th in PM Surya Ghar after Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat and Maharashtra.

new.s: District with the highest beer-sales growth in AP (1–16 Nov 2026)
new.x: Polavaram district recorded the highest beer-sales growth (160%) in AP during 1–16 Nov 2026.

new.s: Total fee reimbursement released by AP since June 2024 (Lokesh, Nov 2026)
new.x: Lokesh's fact sheet (16 Nov 2026) said ₹4,962.22 crore of fee reimbursement was released since June 2024, BCs getting the most.

new.s: Gross capacity of the Somasila reservoir (Nellore), in news Nov 2026
new.x: Somasila (Nellore) has a gross capacity of 78.8 tmc but held only 19.70 tmc in Nov 2026 owing to El Niño and poor rain.

new.s: Combined capital support for a silicon fab under AP's amended Semiconductor Policy 4.0 (Nov 2026)
new.x: AP's amended policy matches the Centre's 40% under Semicon 2.0, giving a silicon fab 80% of eligible capital cost.

new.s: Where will AP's ~5,000-acre Semiconductor Park come up?
new.x: AP plans a ~5,000-acre Semiconductor Park in Tirupati, announced with the amended Semiconductor Policy 4.0 on 18 Nov 2026.

new.s: Largest single proposal on Day 2 of the 31st CII Partnership Summit (13 Nov 2026)
new.x: AirTrunk India–JCK Infra's 1,400 MW data-centre campuses (₹1,03,018 crore) were the largest Day-2 proposal at the CII Summit.

new.s: With whom did Kakinada Seaports Ltd sign its ₹6,452-crore agreement (Nov 2026)?

new.s: Total investment in the 303 agreements of AP's regional conferences plus the 2026 CII Summit

new.s: APCRDA signed an MoU (Nov 2026) for an Integrated Energy Master Plan of Amaravati with

new.s: Union minister who opened the waterfront promenade at Visakhapatnam Port (13 Nov 2026)

new.s: Estimated cost of AP's transmission network under Green Energy Corridor-III (Nov 2026)

new.s: Dates of the Godavari Pushkaralu 2027

new.s: Source of water for AP's Palnadu water grid project
new.x: The Palnadu water grid draws drinking water from the Nagarjuna Sagar reservoir for 889 villages in 33 mandals.

new.s: Cash prize for each Ramoji Excellence Award 2026 winner

new.s: Ramoji Excellence Award 2026 (Science & Technology) went to the developer of India's first home-grown MRI scanner

new.s: 'Waterman of South Zone', a Ramoji Excellence Award 2026 winner
new.x: Podili Rajashekara Raju, the 'Waterman of South Zone', won the Ramoji Excellence Award 2026 for Rural Development & Agriculture.

new.s: Ramoji Excellence Award 2026 'Youth Icon', one of the world's shortest practising doctors
new.x: Dr Ganesh Baraiya of Bhavnagar, Gujarat, one of the world's shortest practising doctors, was the Ramoji Excellence Award 2026 Youth Icon.

new.s: Ramoji Film City, founded by Ramoji Rao, was set up in

new.s: The artist who painted the iconic Lord Venkateswara image for TTD in 1970, died Nov 2026
